shellCommands.command: pwd && git status --short && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ArrowToggle/ArrowToggle.d.ts && grep -n "theme\|view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/ ; grep -rn "theme?:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/*.d.ts | head -5; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite)$"
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit $?"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "vite exit $?"
